name: Rodney O'Quinn

items.why: The item describes no conduct, only that no foreign-government payments, foreign-agent filings or foreign-linked donors turned up, so there is nothing to weigh under foreign ties.

for_review: The item names no controversy, and my searches found none about O'Quinn. I did not search FARA filings or campaign finance records directly. A search of the owner's named sites with his name returned nothing about him. The Lakewood Ranch Beacon profile says he co-founded and owns Keller's Pest Control (a real-work point, but it is his own candidate statement). Election results published Nov 3-4, 2026 show him third of three in Group 1, behind Scott Johnson and Charles Richards.
